exposure: uterine arteries prophylactic occlusion balloon placement (POBP)
Uterine arteries prophylactic occlusion balloon placement (POBP)
cohort: 48 pregnant women with placenta praevia and gestational age at delivery between 33 and 40 weeks
finding: Uterine arteries POBP appears to be a promising technique for reducing hemorrhagic complications in women with placenta praevia, with no significant long-term complications observed.
